changelog: Added LOCAL ONLY mode per profile, with local Home, Channels, Subscriptions, Playlists and History.
In AUTO, YouTube works as usual. If it becomes unavailable, SmartTube LOCAL shows your saved videos instead.
Fixed local subscriptions and several offline navigation issues.
Fixed saved and imported YouTube playlists opening a black screen instead of their video lists.
Preserved existing profiles, [LOCAL] playlists and offline SMB playback.
Fixed playlist video starts opening the next-video carousel and shifting focus away from the player.
Added original LearningMovements playlists to Local Library.
Preserved playlist names, source order and shared video membership for offline SMB playback.
Local Library now loads a Pi-produced catalogue: fast startup without full SMB scans.
Channels load on demand; explicit refresh in Local Library settings.
Inaccurate media sizes and thumbnails update without rescanning.
Fixed empty library handling and improved update reliability.
Repair missing online channel titles and icons without loss of subscriptions.
Added local channel rows and subscriptions.
Added offline playlists.
Added offline Local Library shortcut.
Fixed missing SMB thumbnails.
Added offline playback from an SMB archive.
Enabled Local Library access per profile.
Fixed the black picture during local playback.
SmartTube Local release
Added archived YouTube upload dates and descriptions to local Video Info.
Improved Local Library search, recommendations, channel navigation and visible-card artwork loading.
Preserved profile-scoped AUTO and LOCAL ONLY operation and offline local playback.
